name: Harish Deshpande
card: Harish Deshpande is a sixty-three-year-old retired railway station master in Nagpur who joined through social media over two years ago and shops on his Android phone. A platinum member, he orders most weeks, mainly kitchen staples like atta, ghee, mustard oil and dry fruits, plus some beauty and home items. He has made only one return. He visits the app almost daily and often leaves carts without buying, many of them lately. He has claimed and used about half of the offers he received, dismissed a couple, and has loyalty points still to spend.
